verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Hope be my anthem
Lord when the world has fallen quiet
You stand beside me
Give me a song in the night

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Jesus I need You
Every moment I need You
Hear now this grace bought heart sing out
Your praise forever

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Beauty for ashes
You find the weak and contrite heart
Shoulder its burdens
And carry it into the light

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
Remember love
Remember mercy
Christ before me
Christ behind me

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
Your loving kindness
Has never failed me
Christ before me
Christ behind me
